definitionZh: 中风-中风限制 CSS 属性定义了当 SVG 元素中风路径的角落所使用的形状是中风-width 中风长度与中风-width 比例的上限. 如果超过此属性所定义的限度,则结合从miter转换为belvel,从而使得角显得截断.
sourceDefinition: The stroke-miterlimit CSS property defines a limit on the ratio of the miter length to the stroke-width when the shape to be used at the corners of an SVG element's stroked path is a mitered join. If the limit defined by this property is exceeded, the join is converted from miter to bevel, thus making the corner appear truncated.
